2Speak

Input
    Syntax 
    Lines     Hello there.                    the voice of step 1
          Ann: Hello there.               a @voice, or a library voice by name
          Ann {happy 3}: Hello there.     delivery for the whole line
          {calm 2}: Hello there.
Words     I [really]{emphasis 4} mean it.
Voices    @voice Ann = <library voice> {preset BBC newsreader, age 1, accent irish 1.2, mode reference}
          @voice Me {deep 2}              designed from the voice of step 1
Script    @language en_gb   @mode reference   @seed 42   @laci off|stream|whole
          @decoder <id>   @tags 2   @gap 0.5   @baseline chatty 1, pace -0.5
Other     # comment     \ first: the line is read as text
Tags <laugh/>, <shouting>…</shouting> and pronunciations (S@vQn) work as in Studio.
Language, Seed and LACI above are defaults: @language, @seed and @laci override them.
